relief_modification.evidence: The catalog point lies 0.05 km from the Pena de Hierro mine headframe; the Pena de Hierro open pit (330 x 190 m, ~85 m deep, worked 1883-1960) is 0.12-0.23 km away, inside the central window. Mapped mining features cover 2% (OpenStreetMap landuse=quarry) to 8.6% (CORINE 2012/2018 class 131) of the 9-window area, a lower bound: historic waste dumps and rail cuts are not fully mapped. Masking the mapped features leaves the profile within its uncertainty and the lunar comparisons unchanged (scripts/geomorph_rio_tinto_mask.py), but the unmapped modification cannot be bounded without a pre-mining DEM.
